Method of Attack: Missing capability check in the function mo_wpns_init() allowing unauthenticated attackers to update user passwords and escalate privileges to administrator
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Malware Scanner plugin
WordPress websites using Web Application Firewall plugin
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated attacker arbitrarily updating user passwords
Indicators of Compromise: Ability to upload malicious plugin and theme files

Method of Attack: Privilege escalation by updating user roles, allowing authenticated attackers to elevate privileges to administrator
Attack Vector: Authenticated attacker with subscriber-level permissions or higher updating user roles
Indicators of Compromise: Complete site compromise through administrative access
